text:
maria: quick idea - add a lightweight admission gate to the continuous batcher to route tiny requests to a fastpath and mid-size to a warmup lane, otherwise defer to the batcher.
kevin: admission-only API please: ADMIT_FASTPATH | ADMIT_WARMUP | DEFER_TO_BATCHER. keep scheduler stateless.
maria: agreed. proto sketch: fastpath.max_tokens=32, fastpath.rate_per_tenant=100/min; warmup.range=33..256, warmup.credit_window=10s.
jamal: watch KV-cache warmups. if we fastpath too many small reqs we may hurt larger seq throughput. warmup lane should prioritize cache warmups.
erin: rollout plan: sim-mode for 48h (emit "would_fastpath" metrics), then enable 1% per box -> 10% while monitoring 99p latency and KV-hit-rate. include router kill-switch.
kevin: record reason tags for decisions (over_rate, deadline_hint, capacity) for debugging.
maria: long-term: maybe a tiny model to predict tail impact, but deterministic gates first. i'll draft RFC with enums, proto, telemetry, and rollout by EOD Friday.
kevin: i'll run perf sims. jamal: i'll validate kv-impact. erin: i'll wire alerts for fastpath saturation.
